en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from some of our companions, from Hanan Bin Sadeyr, from Salim Al Hannat who said, 
‘I said to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Inform me about the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High
[26:193] The Trustworthy Spirit has descended with it [26:194] Upon your heart that you may become from the warners [26:195] In clear Arabic language.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is the Wilayah of Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from certain persons of our people from Hanan ibn Sadir from Salim al-Hannat who has said the following. “I aske abu Ja‘far (a.s.), ‘Explain to me the meaning of this verse of the Holy Quran.

“This, (Quran), is certainly the revelation from the Lord of the Universe [26:192]. It has been revealed through the trustworthy Spirit [26:193] to your heart, so that you will warn (the people of the dangers of disobeying God) [26:194]. It has been revealed in plain Arabic.” [26:195]
The Imam (a.s.) said, “It refers to Leadership with Divine Authority of Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.).”
